content.text: Updated: Mar. 15, 2026, 12:01 a.m.Published: Mar. 15, 2026, 12:01 a.m.Mercedes driver George Russell of Britain steers his car during the first practice session ahead of the Chinese Formula One Grand Prix, in Shanghai, China, Friday, March 13, 2026. Learn how you can watch Sunday's grand prix race for free in the U.S. (AP Photo/Andy Wong)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.SHANGHAI -- The 2026 Formula 1 (F1) season has just begun, and it already appears there could be a shift in momentum year-over-year when it comes to the constructors and the racers.The second race of the season is upon us, as the Chinese Grand Prix happens today – Sunday, March 15 – starting at 3 a.m. Eastern on Apple TV+ (free trial).In 2026, Apple TV+ became the exclusive home to F1 racing in the United States. Subscribers can catch all practice, qualifying and Sprint sessions, along with races.If you’re not already a subscriber, Apple TV Plus offers a 7-day free trial. After the free trial, you can cancel or stay subscribed to Apple TV+ for $12.99 per month.F1 drivers to watchGeorge RussellThe lead Mercedes driver took first place in last Sunday’s opener at the Australian Grand Prix, and his car looks to be one to dominate the field this year with new F1 regulations on the cars.Russell and his teammate Kimi Antonelli qualified 1-2 for the Sprint race that happened Saturday ahead of the full race today.Lando NorrisIn 2025, McLaren’s Lando Norris won the Driver’s Championship in the same year that his team won the Constructor’s Championship.While McLaren cars do not look as quick off the line as Mercedes and Ferrari so far this season, it wouldn’t be wise to count out the defending champs in any race this season.Arvid LindbladLindblad, 18, is the youngest driver on the circuit this season, racing for Racing Bulls. He is ready to make his mark after a top 10 finish in his F1 debut last week at the Australian GP.Who is announcing the 2026 Heineken Chinese Grand Prix?Commentary will be led by Alex Jacques alongside former F1 driver Jolyon Palmer, supported by previous Head of Race Strategy, Ruth Buscombe, 13-time F1 race winner, David Coulthard, 2012 GP2 Champion, Davide Valsecchi, European Le Mans Series Champion, Alex Brundle, and Technical Analyst, Sam Collins.New to the team this year are seven-time Formula 1 race winner, Juan Pablo Montoya, and presenter, Betty Glover.What are the latest odds for the Chinese Grand Prix?Note: These odds are as of Friday afternoon.Race WinnerGeorge Russell (-225)Andrea Kimi Antonelli (+350)Charles Leclerc (+1200)Lewis Hamilton (+1200)Oscar Piastri (+1800)Lando Norris (+1800)Max Verstappen (+3500)Odds courtesy DraftKingsCheck out more information on how to watch the 2026 F1 Chinese Grand Prix today:What: 2026 Heineken Chinese Grand Prix When: Sunday, March 15, 2026 Time: 3 a.m. Eastern Where: Shanghai International Circuit | Shanghai, China Only streaming option: Apple TV+ (free trial)Cavs vs. Lakers FREE STREAM today: Where to watch NBA | LeBron JamesGuardians vs. Dodgers FREE STREAM today: Where to watch MLB (3/31/26)Where to stream Jamaica vs. Congo DR live for FREE today | FIFA World Cup playoffGuardians vs. Dodgers FREE STREAM today: Where to watch MLB UConn Final Four gear: Buy 2026 shirts, hoodies, hats Irie Harris joined The Plain Dealer and Cleveland.com, as a Cleveland Browns reporter in August of 2022.
